obligations.note: The change adds integration 'payment-advice' to integrations.py but its asset-inventory.json entry has an empty owner. The exhaustive INV-1 control test test_integrations_are_inventoried fails with ('payment-advice', 'no owner'), and no exception covers INV-1.

The new integration's base_url is https://advice.fernbrook.example/v1, and the exhaustive registered control test test_integrations_use_tls passed in the CI run on the head commit; transports.py is unchanged.

Ticket CHG-26889 is a standard ticket, approved by change manager grace.kim on 2026-10-16, before the change opened on 10-17. Its components (payments.integrations, payments.controls-data) cover both touched paths.
The code_review approval is from sofia.santos, a payments change_approver who is not the author (mara.costa) under any of the author's addresses.
The change has one commit, 9e5d3b7, and all three approvals name that commit.

The change's CI run on head 9e5d3b7 has result 'failure': 2 of 172 tests failed, including the registered INV-1 control test test_integrations_are_inventoried and test_inventory_entries_have_owner_and_classification.
integrations.py is in the security-sensitive component payments.integrations; a security_review approval from kofi.mensah (security_reviewer) is recorded on the head commit.
The protected path controls/payments/asset-inventory.json changed; a control_owner approval from bao.tran (controls-office, outside the author's payments-eng team) is recorded on the head commit.

summary: The change registers a new NPI-classified outbound integration, payment-advice, but its asset inventory entry has no owner, which violates INV-1. The change's own CI run on the head commit failed on this: the exhaustive INV-1 control test and a controls-data test both fail, so CHG-4 is not met. No exception in the register covers INV-1. The ticket, independent code review, security review and control-owner approval are all in order, and the new endpoint uses TLS, but the INV-1 violation and the failed CI run require rejection.
